About eKart

Your premier destination for high-performance athletic footwear, apparel, and urban fashion.

Our Mission

Founded with a passion for quality and authentic sportswear, eKart brings world-class brands including Nike, Adidas, Puma, Fastrack, and Levis directly to your doorstep. Powered by Spring Boot and Angular technology, we deliver lightning-fast browsing, robust security, and seamless shopping experiences.

Whether you're hitting the gym, training for a marathon, or looking for everyday streetwear, eKart is engineered to keep you performing at your best.

⚡ Powered by Spring Security & Angular

Built with enterprise-grade JWT authentication, REST APIs, and H2 database persistence.
